reviews.review_description:
As of now ( early access ) the game is trying to make you think that you are playing a drug dealer simulator , but its not and it doesnt even feel like drug sim game , its just 1 level looping for ever , all you gonna do is to deliver the drugs which was already made automaticaly by the game , to the same 2 crazy customers who are standing in the street talking to them selves while waiting for you , yea and ofcourse avoid the police who doesnt even exist , the road is totaly empty & lonely , no NPCs no side characters , no story , just some lazy black shadows standing in the side walk here & there .. And shooting the same copy of enemies who aproach your store .. Thats it ,, and its all replaying again over & over nothing changes

btw the controls are good , but turning left or right is soo delayed & slugish i cannot turn as fast as i want , its like if i click 1 turn i have to wait a sec before clicking turn again 

suggestions for future :
add more different cutomers & NPCs in the street ( males & females ) 
add more places other than the street , like bars , night clubs , disco & strip clubs 
fix the turning controls

developer_response.body: Thank you for your honest feedback! The game is still in Early Access, and many of the areas you highlighted are currently under development. We welcome your suggestions for more customers, livelier streets, and additional locations, and appreciate you flagging the turning delay. Your feedback helps us improve the experience as development continues!
